offer.text: Whatever this long search has cost us, I want to mark its end with warmth, not grief. Bring a cake and we'll set a table — a homecoming, in hope or in memory.

accept.text: Thank you. Come share it with us. You're family now, after all this.

decline.text: Please — don't let it end on a cold note. Not after everything.

in_progress.text: Is the cake coming? The table feels too quiet without it.

ready.text: A proper cake. Sit with us, won't you? You've earned a place at this table.

complete.text: Through every dark mile of this, you never once turned away. Whatever the woods took from us, they couldn't take that. We will never forget you.
